method: spGFN2-xTB (tblite 0.7.0, spin-polarization 1.0), every state optimized from the production geometry (restricted GFN2 at the drawn or metal_v1 multiplicity, the engine's embedding) and from it displaced by a fixed Gaussian kick (0.02 Angstrom, seed 0); the lower energy among the converged starts that formed no bond the drawing lacks (non-metal pairs within the wall factor, 1.2 x the covalent-radius sum; else BOND_FORMED). v2: a state of a carbene (one centre holding the two radical electrons, AC12's kind) whose every start formed one takes its single-point energy at the production geometry, an upper bound (bounded); B reads the production geometry re-optimized from the displaced start when that ends more than 1e-05 Ha lower without a new bond
